content: JESUS NUG EḎUA HIBAIṮOM
Juda dilag Meṯid deḏ Sarere amu uḵa male, Meṯidp̱a buṯua aam beḵunu heehe, Maria, Magdala ted amu Maria laa ele a moḏ anidḵulahnu gopiḏ.
Uḵeheh am mim oḵai neum. Aḏinu? Kayaknu engel laa hab aṯannu na, moḏ ameg kola, men amu qaḏep̱a heḏep na dayom.
Nug iḏu am amemḏi bia amahlom. Nuhig lamen amu haḵabnab ais bia.
Ban danab ag nuhignu baḏaeg, beḏulag hahaḏeḏe, danab mauhak bia niip̱ig.
Am engel nug ah aḏit amelahp̱a aum. “A aib baḏapiḏ! Da dooṯem, a Jesus, ad emaitakp̱a atulp̱ig ele amu, Nug madiṯep.
Nug ip̱a ii daaṯe, nug anuḵa aum bia eḏua hibaiṯom! A doya, Nug niiom aben iiḵud anṯeḏ!
Antoya am pahanab goya, nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab amelagp̱a, ‘Nug moḏp̱anu eḏua hibaiṯom!’ aoya aiḏ! Doyeḏ! Nug anuqa Galelia uḵeb, ag Nug ap̱a anidḵulag! Da geha iiḵu a amelahp̱a aṯem!” awa aum.
Engel anam a amu ah aḏit a oṯaiya baḏaya, oolah gamag ele ahehe, moḏ uuya, nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab amelagp̱a aḵulahnu qaiqaḏ gopiḏ.
A anam uḵaeheh am Jesus ib manp̱a a gumata do, a ele nug uḏa tena amu Nug, “Buṯua ena,” awa aum. Jesus anam a amu a Nug guḵuidya waya, baeg aḏai daaiya, binag mepiḏ.
A anam heeheh amu Jesus Nug a amelahp̱a aum. “A aib baḏapiḏ! Goya, da awalad amalad amelagp̱a apeḏ doona, ag gona, Galelia ap̱a da aniḏeg!” awa aum.
DAUP AG KEEKE ANIDP̱IGNU AEG, IḴI DANAB DOOP̱IG
Aria ah aḏit uḵaeheh, ban danab laala ag Jerusalem nona, ag keeke aḏi aḏi beum amu oh mana meṯak iḵi danab amelagp̱a ap̱ig.
Amelagp̱a aeg amu mana meṯak iḵi danab amu Juda iḵi danab ele ag qag mena, nai maṯin amu ban danab men doḏo oḵai maṯana ap̱ig.
“Ag, ‘Ig niiutut, nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab tuqan uḏin, Nug gaḏa yab aop̱ig,’ aon aig!
Aria gabman oḵai Pilatus nug nai amu doya heeb amu ig nug amegp̱a imunu aḵunig amunu ag ug laa ii anidmana,” aon ap̱ig.
Anam aeg amu ban danab ag men doḏo aona, ag mana meṯak iḵi danab ag aḏi heḵulagnu ap̱ig amu anamib hep̱ig. Anam heeg amu nai amu Juda danab kuḏum doon malaeg uḏie, gemu ele madiṯeb.
JESUS NUG IP̱UNIṮAK AWAK DANAB UḎAT MAṮOM
Aria ip̱uniṯak awak danab elewen ag Galelia ap̱a qauko laap̱a, Jesus goḵulagnu aum, amup̱a gop̱ig.
Gona, ap̱a ag Nug anidna, binag mep̱ig amge laala ag oolagp̱a dab mak aḏit ele dayom.
Anam heegeg, Jesus Nug ag gumaṯa doa, amelagp̱a aum. “Kayak Nug da keeke oh iḵilag daaḵulnu meiḏom
amunu ag gona, wan atu ohp̱anu danab ah hep̱eg, dahilad ip̱uniṯak awak danab ah daap̱eg, ag Mama onigp̱a, Nug Beḵa onigp̱a amu Kayak Ouḏi onigp̱a layaṯeg!
Ag keeke oh da ag heḵulagnu amelagp̱a ami amu, ag amu oh ele ip̱uanaṯeg! Ag doyeg! Da haen oh ag ele daap̱ut uḵeb, gog tak haenp̱a bataḵu,” awa aum.
